title: pvPassArrays
body:
## pvPassArrays

Generated binding of ParaView's Pass Arrays: keeps only the selected arrays of each association (point, cell, field, and for graphs and tables vertex, edge and row data) and removes the rest, with geometry unchanged. An association whose list is empty passes none of its arrays. Unlike the curated passArrays, omitted lists are not set by Schemaxis, so ParaView's own initial selection applies; name every list whose arrays matter.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Omitted lists keep ParaView's initial selection, which Schemaxis has not verified; give an explicit list (possibly []) for every association you care about.
- Row arrays are the columns of a table; use RowDataArrays, not PointDataArrays, for vtkTable input.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PassArrays`. Identity: `filters/PassArrays`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellDataArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EdgeDataArrays` | Select the edge data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FieldDataArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointDataArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RowDataArrays` | Select the row data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VertexDataArrays` | Select the vertex data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPassArrays",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
